title: Rams and Chargers’ SoFi Stadium gets a surprise ranking among NFL venues

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams and Chargers’ SoFi Stadium gets a surprise ranking among NFL venues
sources.description: SoFi Stadium, home of the Rams and Chargers, ranks as the NFL's fourth-loudest venue in a surprising new study. But whose fans are making all that noise?
